# Music commands

## `music.albums.get`

Show an album: its artist, year, length, genre, and format.

- CLI: `media music albums get`
- Kind: query
- Scope: music:read
- Arguments: `{ albumId: Id<"albums"> }`
- Result: `{ album: { id: Id<"albums">; title: string; artist: string; artistId: Id<"artists">; year: number | null; artUrl: string | null; trackCount: number }; durationMs: number; genre: string | null; format: string }`

## `music.play.report`

Record that a song you started is playing, once per start, in your history.

- CLI: `media music play report`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: music:play
- Arguments: `{ trackId: Id<"tracks">; playbackId: string }`
- Result: `{ recorded: boolean }`

## `music.play.reportOffline`

Record songs a device played offline in your history (500 at most); a play sent again records once.

- CLI: `media music play report-offline`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: music:play
- Arguments: `{ plays: Array<{ trackId: Id<"tracks">; playedAt: number }>; sentAt: number }`
- Result: `{ recorded: number }`

## `music.play.start`

Start a song: get a stream ticket for it in this session.

- CLI: `media music play start`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: music:play
- Arguments: `{ trackId: Id<"tracks"> }`
- Result: `{ trackId: Id<"tracks">; playbackId: string; startedAt: number; ticket: string; expiresAt: number }`

## `music.playlists.addTracks`

Add songs to the end of a playlist you own or collaborate on (2,000 songs at most); send any songs left in rest again.

- CLI: `media music playlists add-tracks`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: music:edit
- Arguments: `{ playlistId: Id<"playlists">; trackIds: Array<Id<"tracks">> }`
- Result: `{ itemIds: Array<Id<"playlistItems">>; rest: Array<Id<"tracks">> }`

## `music.playlists.create`

Create a playlist, with songs to start it.

- CLI: `media music playlists create`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: music:edit
- Arguments: `{ name: string; description?: string; trackIds?: Array<Id<"tracks">> }`
- Result: `{ playlistId: Id<"playlists">; rest: Array<Id<"tracks">> }`

## `music.playlists.get`

- Kind: query
- Scope: music:read
- Arguments: `{ paginationOpts: { numItems: number; cursor: string | null; endCursor?: string | null; id?: number; maximumRowsRead?: number; maximumBytesRead?: number } }`

## `music.queue.add`

Add songs to your queue: --next plays them after the current song, otherwise they go after your other queued songs (before autoplay); send any songs left in rest again with --after-item-id set to the last item id added so far.

- CLI: `media music queue add`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: music:play
- Arguments: `{ trackIds: Array<Id<"tracks">>; next?: boolean; afterItemId?: Id<"playQueueEntries"> }`
- Result: `{ itemIds: Array<Id<"playQueueEntries">>; rest: Array<Id<"tracks">> }`

## `music.queue.autoplay`

Turn autoplay on or off: when the queue runs out, play the same artist, then genre, then era.

- CLI: `media music queue autoplay`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: music:play
- Arguments: `{ on: boolean }`
- Result: `null`

## `music.queue.clear`

Clear everything after the current song.

- CLI: `media music queue clear`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: music:play
- Arguments: none
- Result: `null`

## `music.queue.get`

Show your queue: the entry playing, how many there are, shuffle, repeat, and autoplay.

- CLI: `media music queue get`
- Kind: query
- Scope: music:play
- Arguments: none
- Result: `{ current: Id<"playQueueEntries"> | null; count: number; shuffle: boolean; repeat: "off" | "all" | "one"; autoplay: boolean }`

## `music.queue.jump`

Make a queue entry the one playing.

- CLI: `media music queue jump`
- Kind: mutation
- Scope: music:play
- Arguments: `{ itemId: Id<"playQueueEntries"> }`
- Result: `null`

List your queue's entries in play order.

- Kind: query

- Arguments: `{ paginationOpts: { numItems: number; cursor: string | null; endCursor?: string | null; id?: number; maximumRowsRead?: number; maximumBytesRead?: number } }`

- Result: `{ page: Array<{ itemId: Id<"playQueueEntries">; autoplay: boolean; track: { id: Id<"tracks">; title: string; artist: string; artistId: Id<"artists">; album: string; albumId: Id<"albums">; trackNumber: number | null; discNumber: number | null; durationMs: number; codec: string; lossless: boolean; bitrate: number | null; sampleRate: number | null; bitDepth: number | null; artUrl: string | null; liked: boolean } }>; continueCursor: string; isDone: boolean; splitCursor?: string | null; pageStatus?: "SplitRecommended" | "SplitRequired" | null }`
